title: An NSGo app in the showcase, one file per app named after its slug

kind.description: The language the app is written in: go for an app written in Go, tsx for one written in TSX (a TSX app with Go of its own, nsgo init -template mixed, is tsx). Both draw each platform's native views.

platforms.description: Platforms the app ships for: mac (macOS), win (Windows), linux, ios (iOS, with its App Clips, tvOS and watchOS), android, web (the browser, through WebAssembly) or miniprogram (WeChat, QQ, Alipay or Douyin mini programs).

category.description: What kind of app it is, as a schema.org applicationCategory that Google accepts, for the app page's structured data. Leave out to take the group's (GROUP_CATEGORY in src/catalog.ts).

group.description: The showcase's group: agents for tools for AI coding agents (terminals and workspaces for them, their usage, quotas and skills); dev for other developer tools (Git, editors, terminals, SSH, databases, API clients, cloud storage); ai for AI assistants (chat clients, writing, translation, voice input, local models); network for proxy and VPN clients; notes for notes, documents and reading (Markdown, PDF, OCR, RSS); system for system and file utilities (cleaning, files, clipboard, screenshots, remote desktop, menu bar tools); devices for hardware and the smart home (chargers, monitors, peripherals, Home Assistant); media for music, video, audio and images; game for games and their launchers; chat for messaging, mail and notifications. The completing script picks it when the submission names none.

url.description: The app's homepage: its website, or its repository when it has none.

repo.description: Its GitHub repository as owner/name, for an open-source app. Leave out for a closed-source one.

summary.description: One line, for cards and search.

description.description: A sentence or two, for the detail drawer.

screenshot.description: A file in apps/web/public/shots/. A phone app may give a portrait one.

icon.description: The app icon: its yldm-tech/ai-logo id, or a file in apps/web/public/icons/. Leave out for the letter tile.

provisional.description: The images that stand in until the project gives its own: the owner's GitHub avatar for an icon, GitHub's card of the repository or a card drawn of it for a screenshot. The completing script sets it; the announcement's issue asks the project for them; whoever replaces one drops it from the list.

added.description: When the app joined the showcase, in UTC (e.g. 2026-11-04T12:00:00Z). The showcase can list apps newest first by it.
